summary: This directory contains the core configuration interfaces for concept analysis, enabling the systematic definition and tracking of architectural targets during project analysis and documentation generation workflows.
responsibilities: Configure parameters for architectural concept analysis
Define settings for target-specific path resolution
Enable change tracking configuration for analysis processes
Extend base analysis capabilities with custom target options
relationships: The analysis options interface defines the required configuration parameters for the system's core analysis engine.
Target path configurations established here inform the file system resolution logic used by the analysis and documentation generators.
designDecisions: Use of interface-based configuration to allow extensibility across different analysis targets
Strict separation between configuration definitions and operational logic
Centralization of analysis settings to ensure consistent behavior across project scanning phases
